amendments.execution_path: vllm bench throughput accepts kv_cache_dtype=rabit_kv2 but samples at temperature 1.0 and exposes no per-request timestamps / token IDs required by the pre-registered metrics and audit; the sweep uses the vLLM multi-request LLM.generate API validated by the accepted concurrency correctness smoke. Benchmark-harness change only.
amendments.max_num_seqs: max_num_seqs = target concurrency C at every point, identical for BF16 and RABIT.

rabit_extension_rule: RABIT-only points {128, 256} may be run ONLY after review, and only if BF16 fails first (BF16 is not sustained_target_concurrency at some base point where RABIT is, in every trial); never chosen from the throughput shape
prompt_construction: BOS 128000 + pseudo-random ordinary vocabulary IDs in [1000, 30000) from SHA-256(tag:length:index:position); see exp6_workload.py
